errors.text_span: The charts visually emphasize the dominance of successful high-precision corrections in both overall changes and actual errors, while also highlighting the relatively small but non-negligible proportion of undetected errors that are erroneously altered.
errors.evidence: This sentence offers interpretation ("visually emphasize the dominance"), draws conclusions ("dominance of successful... corrections"), and uses subjective evaluative language ("relatively small but non-negligible"), all of which are explicitly forbidden by the generation prompt.
The description fails to mention that several slices in both charts are visually emphasized by being offset or 'exploded' from the main circle, which was an explicit requirement of the prompt.
The description does not explicitly state the total number of slices (six) in each chart, as requested by the prompt.
